items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And what about the Christian boys? Do you remember them? All of them. Yeah. All Frank Christian, Charlie Christian, Johnny Christian. [INTERVIEWEE] Emil?

ctx.x: Well, it just, it just, just like you see those men playing now, they have a band that comes on now. What is that band? The Polish band that comes on?
Huh? It, I can't call it our band. But, uh, they play exactly like that riverfront.
